criteria.name: Explicit root-cause statement in commit message
criteria.evidence:
git log -1 --format=%B shows commit message: 'dla: fix invisible cluster by bringing spawn ring close and lowering stickiness

Root cause: default spawnRadius=0.48 placed walkers ~60 cells from the seed on a 512px canvas. With maxWalkSteps=256 and stickiness=1, most walkers hit the kill radius or wandered off before ever touching the cluster. The aggregate never grew past the initial seed.

Fix: reduce spawnRadius to 0.05 (gap ~6 cells), raise maxWalkSteps to 400, lower stickiness to 0.45 (allows walkers to slip into gaps), and seed 4 cells for a rounder core. Cluster now reaches 100+ particles in ~3s at default settings.'

criteria.name: Cluster reaches 100+ stuck particles within 30 seconds at defaults
criteria.evidence: Ran headless Playwright test against dev server (npm run dev) on /#/diffusion-limited-aggregation. After 30 seconds, kernel.clusterSize read via console evaluation was 1,247 particles. Visual inspection confirms visible coral-like cluster growing from center. Screenshot saved to /tmp/dla-30s.png showing dense aggregate.

The selfTest() at line 506 also passes with deterministic parameters. npm test runs 3/3 DLA tests passing.

additional_findings: Contract test gate: scripts/check-contract-test-gate.sh passed. Assertions digest matches card declaration (no frozen block in this card, gate skipped gracefully). The worker's fix is minimal and well-justified: the spawnRadius reduction from 0.48 to 0.05 is the key lever — walkers now spawn adjacent to the cluster edge instead of far outside the kill radius. The stickiness reduction to 0.45 produces the 'dense coral' morphology described in the commit message. All criteria satisfied.
